steps.content: It's a dream-like space, confusing and disorienting. The whispering of a distant tide caresses your eardrums, like a sleep-inducing lullaby. You search for a way out but to no avail.
Come, let me show you the way...

Shallow footprints extend to the distance. They move apart, only to come together shortly after; they disappear, only to reappear moments later. At the end of the trail stands a thin apparition. It is flickering.
Only the crisp sound of a bell can be heard.
